prerequisites: Solution of system of equations (linear, nonlinear)

learning_outcomes.text: Define and introduce basic terms, computational models, theories and algorithms of static problem solutions, necessary for Dynamics and Strength of Materials.

Acquire basic knowledge of mechanics of solids, description and classification of force systems, determination of their characteristics and resultants as well as possibility of their equivalent replacement.
Be made familiar with computational models of body connections without and with friction.
Acquire knowledge of kinematic and static analysis of supported and connected solids and mechanisms, equilibrium solution and concept of free-body diagram.
Be able to solve static problems using basic graphic methods.
Be able to calculate the internal resultant forces and moments in straight bars.

syllabus_topics: Definition of mechanics, basic concepts, force, moment of force about a point, moment of force about an axis.
Force systems, their classification and characteristic features, gravity, center of gravity.
Equivalent force systems.
Static equilibrium of a rigid body – characteristics of bonds without passive effect, basic models of body connections.
Numerical solutions of the static equilibrium of a bound body.
Graphical solutions of the static equilibrium of a bound body.
Solving the static equilibrium of systems of bodies – numerically and graphically.
Trusses structures.
Bonds with a passive effect – analysis and calculation models, basic models of body connections.
Solution of the static equilibrium of a bound body with bonds with a passive effect.
Solving the static balance of a system of bodies with a passive effect.
Bar – definition and basic characteristics, loading and bonds.
Internal resultant forces and moments in straight rods – an integral and differential approach.
Force, moment of force about a point and about an axis.
Force and moment resultants of force system.
Replacement of a force system by an equivalent force.
Centre of gravity determination.
Static equilibrium of a bound body.
Static equilibrium of movable body.
Computational solutions of equilibrium of rigid body system.
Graphical solutions of equilibrium of rigid body system.
Computational and graphical solution of trusses structures.
Static equilibrium of movable body with passive resistances.
Static equilibrium of movable body system with passive resistances.
Internal resultant forces and moments in straight rods – an integral and differential approach.

assessment_methods.method: Final written solution of typical tasks (part 2)

assessment_rules: The course-unit credit is granted under the condition of active participation in seminars and passing the seminar tests of basic knowledge (at least 10 ECTS points out of 20 must be gained). The final examination is divided into two parts: a cross-sectional written test (max 40 ECTS points) and a written solution of typical tasks (max 40 ECTS points). Progression to the second part requires at least 20 ECTS points from the first part. To pass the course, at least 50 ECTS points must be reached from the sum of points gained in seminars and at the examination. Attendance at practical training is obligatory.
